name: Thmanyah Font (خط ثمانية)
summary: Arabic typeface family by Thmanyah, free to download for personal and commercial design work.
description: An Arabic typeface drawn to feel handwritten, with a Serif Display cut in five weights (light to heavy) for headlines, a Serif Text cut for long articles and a Sans cut for digital interfaces. It supports OpenType stylistic alternates, is downloaded as font files and installs on macOS or Windows, and updates are sent to the email used for the download. Thmanyah's own license permits personal and commercial design use but forbids redistribution, modification and derivative fonts.
contains: Serif Display cut in 5 weights: light, regular, medium, bold, heavy
45+ Arabic typefaces studied over 1,200+ hours of research
free download for personal and commercial design use
OpenType stylistic alternates for connected letterforms
